what: exact-membership comparison of the mask produced by the repaired importer against the authoritative mask used for the published analysis
export: the pinned HLA Eplet Registry per-allele export, accessed 2026-08-05 (ABC and DR/DQ/DP databases)
note: the export itself is held under licence outside this repository and is not redistributed

selection_rule.filter: Evidence in {A1, A2, B} OR Exposition == 'High'
selection_rule.positions: flattened resi column, intersected with the positions the agreement matrix covers

hardcoding_note: the importer contains no list of expected positions; EXPECTED_N holds only the two counts, and is used for a warning, never to select positions
